claude-storymodel4s-m1 FOLLOW-UP 27e8bec on worktree-agent-a50b8fa1f911392ac, on top of 3c1777e (not amended, not rebased; 27e8bec is the proposed landing SHA). 7 files, +233/-71: align/{hsmm,wire}.scala, GateProofSuite, WireSuite, laws/{AlignGens,Laws}.scala, docs/adr/0001. Not merged.

Chief REQUIRED items (post-01M15GJPQJVJ59QF5V1ASKJBXE):
(1) MEDIUM regression — GraphHsmm.infer now drops candidates absent from the view from BOTH the nominated map (infer: anchorsByUnit filtered by view.node.nonEmpty) and the cost keys (run: view.node(ref).toVector.flatMap — no unreachable key is emitted). validated still refuses absent anchors (nomination pass unchanged). No count/list added to the result (kept the HsmmResult shape stable for codec; can add on request). Test: GateProofSuite 'a candidate absent from the view is dropped by infer, never nominated (alien candidate)' — alien nomination on every unit yields Right, equal to the plain result, alien in no anchors/cost keys, no exclusion anywhere. Exclusion.Unreachable / CostBreakdown.unreachable remain as bookkeeping types (still used by test forgeries), no longer produced by run.
(2) hsmm.scala derive: view.node(ref).map(...) via flatMap, no .get.
(3) docs: wire.scala costBreakdown Scaladoc + ADR D5.1 'total is a cached value, not verified on the wire (weights/function prior not on the record; carry CostWeights/FunctionPrior and recompute if needed)'; AdmissibilityEcho.of is now TAGGED (Render.Tokens: entries, then per (unit, anchor) sorted: unit, anchor, contradictions list, faithful, facets list) and the ADR admissibility-echo/v1 line says exactly that; foil forgery law retitled 'every forgery of a foil result — mass, key, cost, path, flow, cross-record — is rejected (the un-nominated class is covered by the Case-based law: a foil nominates every node)'.

Reviewer nits (post-01M15H51TJVDGS1W6F4XDMG9JR): (1) Render.Tokens emits tag, length (decimal UTF-16 units), value for every field; lists emit count then length-prefixed elements; Render.composite length-prefixes each component — applied to view-fingerprint/v1, recall-checksum/v1 and admissibility-echo/v1 (all /v1 kept, unshipped); ADR sentence now says length-prefixed with the outcome/cause re-bracketing example; both re-bracketing pairs added as must-differ variants in WireSuite (NodeSummary and PropositionSketch) and in AlignGens.fingerprintVariants (law). (2) evidence on/other toggles in WireSuite node variants and AlignGens.fingerprintVariants; recall-checksum test gains evidence-only, evidence-other, ordinal-only, participant alias/specified/head; all variants pairwise distinct. (3) structuralReduction now rejects a Missing estimate over members that reduce to a value (test 'a missing reduction cannot hide members that reduce to a value').

Evidence at the clean pin (27e8bec): alignJVM 119 / alignJS 119 / alignNative 119 (was 117: +alien candidate, +missing-over-members), lawsJVM 76 / lawsJS 76, fixturesJVM 96, interviewJVM 30, embedGrakern + codecJVM Test/compile, scalafmtCheckAll — all green; no warnings from my files.
